profile_text.body:
Lokalise describes itself as a continuous localization and translation management platform that integrates into development workflows. The company says its system connects workflows, standardizes execution, and uses AI to deliver consistent, on-brand experiences. Its AI applies approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary, and it uses Custom AI Profiles, surrounding context, and metadata to preserve meaning. AI Scoring evaluates translation quality automatically, with human review only for low-confidence results. Lokalise also says it dynamically selects and routes to the best-fit LLM based on language, content, and context, and it applies role-based access control across the platform and its API.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Newark, Delaware. Its AI product is Lokalise AI, a localization AI offering with continuous translation, developer workflow integration, and UK hosting. The company's Delaware law exposure record lists 33 entries, and no litigation cases are recorded.
